scope: Bounded independent read-only review of frozen managed SD16 schema3/order1 SDK/export integration, no source edits/builds/tests/hardware.

findings.topic: Mandatory coverage versus optional IMU quality
findings.evidence: NpV2SdGrid.cs34-68 validates outer seals/profile/stride/N/P/H/A and complete admitted coverage before output; constructor70-84 and Feed88-98 retain optional context/carrier failures separately; DatExport368-376 records optional grid status without changing intact NN extents.

NpV2SdDatExport.cs592-641 allocates one8-byte index entry per durable physical group from validated footer112, scans only that physical extent, validates four consecutive aligned original IDs/profile/source ticks, rejects duplicates and recomputes exact P/H. No reservation-sized bitmap or neural payload caching.

IndexGridAppend625-629 reads each physical group AUX in physical order with original logical parent first+3, before Array.Sort633. Logical decoder238-242 changes NN read order only;287 skips AUX for gridAppend. NpImuGridWriter owns monotonic slot/optional-quality handling.

findings.topic: Partial holes preserve data and do not forge acquisition loss
findings.evidence: DatExport277-286 and USBConsoleVerifier2870-2877 create explicit offline stored-segment boundaries. Decoder1288-1297 retires partial rows and reuses verified absolute phase without cross-hole splicing. SourceGap counters update only actual tick mismatch2980-2985, not storage gaps. Segment IDs/ticks/row offsets retained in neural_segments.csv and first_sample_timestamps.json.

findings.topic: Missing initial NN cannot qualify first-source phase
findings.evidence: GridFirstSource728-744 reparses actual recorded clock/root and requires identity header logical sequence0/source tick0; missing prefix fails that predicate. DatExport370 also requires initialSequence0/no storage holes for verified whole-source window.

Index progress631 is once per64 physical groups; decode294-298 once per64 NN blocks, never per row. SDK progress100 occurs only finally467 after final DAT publication/receipt. GUI329 clamps local99 and final384 sets100 after export/merge/conversion loop. Stage ETA is separate; later phases remain unknown.

limits: This review does not replace the existing focused fixture results and does not independently rerun them.
Firmware C/writer/pool/metadata parity and hardware acceptance remain pending with their owners.
No payload CRC or session-token proof is fabricated by indexing; whole-clock lifetime and physical sensor conversion phase remain outside scope.
